propositions: Bug tickets lack a recorded detection channel (canary, CI, review-bot, human audit, user report), preventing measurement of escape-channel trends.
Capture of detection source must occur at ticket creation time via environment variable or optional CLI flag, with zero added friction to filing.
The detected_by field must be stamped present-only in compiled state and events; absence must reduce byte-identically to pre-change reduction to ensure backward compatibility.
The detected_by value undergoes normalization (strip + lowercase) with empty/whitespace treated as unset; unknown tokens are preserved verbatim without enum enforcement or creation failure.
The implementation must converge all local ingress paths (CLI, library, MCP) through create_core while explicitly excluding Jira inbound reconciliation to avoid mis-attribution.
